title: Minimum structured encounter state (CC-009 design, noncanonical)
description: The minimum per-encounter state for reliable theater-of-mind combat, grid-ready. It is a PROJECTION derived from committed events (never GM-written directly), published per viewer. Fields marked 'existing' are already published in turn-contract/3 contexts or the Atomic engine state; 'gap' fields are proposals evidenced by Hask Meadow r2.

order.description: gap in live: allied NPCs acting in combat (Wick, round 10) have no entry. Owner decision D2.

hazards.description: gap: environmental changes (the live ember in the cut, evt_1356; the scorched gouge with an ember, evt_1403) are prose only.

receipts.description: existing (roll_log + dice display redaction; Atomic receipts)

hp.description: Own PC: number. Others: a condition word (Atomic playerProjection). Never a hidden number.

resources.description: e.g. FP; and charges for weapons (gap: the blaster's charge is 'not tracked in the record', evt_1412).

hands.description: existing for Aero; gap for NPCs (Wick's hands are prose only).

state.description: lit/unlit, holstered, drawn, held by another

knowledge.description: Bounded: what this actor knows (TB4 actor-scoped envelopes). The player view never includes another actor's private knowledge.

intent_state.description: gap: 'don't fire till I say' (evt_1389) is prose; NPC agency still decides.

durability.description: gap: the hatch planks were cut and burned through (evt_1243) but carry no durability; Wick's shot used 'total cover' vs a hidden DC.
